title: Chunk Limit For Simulated Rubies
description: Configurable Chunk Loader limits for Simulated Rubies.
body:
**Chunk Limit for Simulated Rubies** adds configurable placement limits for Simulated Rubies Chunk Loaders. Prevent chunk loader spam, improve server performance, and keep multiplayer gameplay fair.

### Config Options

* **maxChunkLoadersPerPlayer** - Set how many Chunk Loaders each player can place.
* **adminBypass** - Allow admins/operators to ignore the limit.
* **trackedBlock** - Choose which block should be limited.
